flow.costPlain: Everything it costs to run the restaurants themselves: food, beverage and packaging ($972M), crew labor ($848M), occupancy ($179M) and other operating costs ($526M).

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: Running the company above the restaurant level — headquarters, marketing and support.

opex.name: Depreciation and amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of restaurant build-outs, equipment and technology.

opex.name: Pre-opening costs
opex.note: Costs to open new restaurants before they serve their first burrito bowl.

opex.name: Impairment and closure costs
opex.note: Writing down or closing underperforming locations, and disposing of assets.

follow100Note: More than three-quarters of every $100 never leaves the restaurant — ingredients, crew and rent eat it on site. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
footerNote: Chipotle doesn't report gross profit; the middle step is its own 'restaurant-level operating profit' — revenue minus the four costs of running the restaurants.

kpis.label: Restaurant-level margin
kpis.note: of revenue, at the store level

oneTimers: Inside the $13.25M impairment and closure line sits a $4.3M write-down of restaurant assets; together with $1.5M of retention-equity stock pay in G&A, these are the only items between GAAP net income of $339.9M and adjusted net income of $344.6M.
Chipotle repurchased $110M of its own stock in the quarter at an average of $34.05, with $1.6B of buyback authorization remaining.
otherDetail: Other income was $5M — mostly interest earned on Chipotle's cash balances.
pngFooterNote: The middle step is Chipotle's restaurant-level operating profit.

segments.name: Food and beverage revenue
segments.note: Burritos, bowls and drinks across 4,267 company-owned restaurants. Digital orders were 38.8% of this revenue, and 84 new restaurants opened in the quarter — 53 of them with a Chipotlane drive-thru.

segments.name: Delivery service revenue
segments.note: Delivery fees Chipotle collects on orders placed through its own app and website — a sliver next to the food itself.

takeaways.text: Comparable sales rose 2.1% — transactions up 0.8% and average check up 1.3% — a third straight quarter of positive traffic. Digital sales climbed to 38.8% of food and beverage revenue.
takeaways.title: Traffic is growing again

takeaways.text: Chipotle opened 84 company-owned restaurants (53 with a Chipotlane) plus 5 partner-operated abroad, passing 4,200 total locations. Full-year guidance is unchanged: low-single-digit comp growth and 350–370 openings.
takeaways.title: The store machine keeps building

takeaways.text: Food, beverage and packaging costs fell to 29.5% of revenue from 30.0%, thanks to price increases, tariff relief and limited-time-offer mix — partly offset by beef and freight inflation. Restaurant-level margin was 23.3%.
takeaways.title: Food costs finally eased

verdict: Chipotle grew revenue 9.6% to $3.3B — comparable sales up 2.1% with traffic positive for a third straight quarter, plus 84 new restaurants — though net profit fell 11% to $340M as costs below the restaurant line climbed.
